decisions.statement: A session's id changes when the agent changes and never otherwise.
A session is found by its id rather than by where its file is kept.
Each line of a session records the working directory that line was written under.
A session records no working directory of its own.
Moving a live session's file makes the writer open a new file at the old path.
That new file has only the lines written after the move.

definition: one conversation Claude Code can pick up again
